summary_1line: Yudhishthira urges Satyaki to rescue Arjuna battling deep within the Kaurava army, and Satyaki vows to reach him despite the immense opposing host.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna’s chariot is swallowed by a vast ocean of Kaurava troops as dust rises and conchs and drums thunder across the battlefield.
Yudhishthira, anxious amid the war camp, implores the warrior Satyaki to ride out and rescue Arjuna before the day ends.
Satyaki stands armed on his chariot, vowing to carve through the entire Kaurava army to reach Arjuna surrounded by enemies.
